title: Death of Ninus (Nimrod)
summary: CFAH AP-48: death of Ninus/Nimrod, 2068 BC (Atothis of Egyptian Dynasty 1 identified with Nimrod).
description: CFAH-5 counts from Menes founding Thinis (2188 BC) through the 62-year reign of Menes and the 57-year reign of Atothis, whom it identifies as Nimrod (Manetho via Africanus). Scripture gives no date for Nimrod's death.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-48: Death of Ninus/Nimrod: 2068 B.C."
chronologies.note: CFAH-5: "2188 B.C. Menes founds Thinis; minus, 62 year reign of Menes; minus, 57 year reign of Atothis (Nimrod)"
Jones (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament, 2002) gives no date for this extra-biblical event.
No matching entry found in Ussher's Annals.
